news.text:
Ciuc Navi welcomes a new face to its active Counter-Strike 2 roster!

Following the recent departure of stfandrei from the starting lineup, we're pleased to announce that RADUTNT has officially passed his trials and earned his place among the main five.

After proving his abilities during the trial period, RADUTNT has shown that he has what it takes to represent the team. More importantly, he's arriving with the right mentality: commitment, determination and a willingness to fight with his life for Ciuc Navi. Whether that means winning a 1v3 clutch or defending the honour of the team in Premier, we expect nothing less.

We're excited to see what he brings to the roster and look forward to the games, challenges and questionable tactical decisions ahead.

Welcome to Ciuc Navi, RADUTNT! Your trial is over. Now the real grind begins.

Once NAVI, always NAVI.

news.text:
An unexpected incident has left two members of the Ciuc Navi main roster temporarily sidelined, following a controversial series of events involving a third-party player.

Ciuc Navi has found itself facing an unexpected setback after two of its main roster players received seven-day VAC cooldowns. The situation came as a surprise to the team, especially considering that neither player was knowingly involved in any cheating activity.

So, what exactly happened?

During their recent Premier sessions, our players queued alongside another individual whom they believed to be a completely legitimate Counter-Strike player. At the time, there was no apparent reason to suspect anything unusual. However, it later became clear that this individual had been using cheats, turning what seemed like an ordinary gaming session into an unfortunate situation for everyone involved.

As a consequence, two of our players ended up receiving VAC cooldowns, despite not knowingly playing with a cheater. While we cannot change what has happened, we want to make one thing clear: our players' intention was simply to play the game, compete and enjoy their time on the server. They were not knowingly teaming up with someone using cheats, and this incident has certainly not been part of any team strategy.

Two Players Sidelined, One Team Still Standing

The seven-day cooldowns mean that two members of our main roster will temporarily be unable to participate in Premier matches. Naturally, this creates an unexpected challenge for the team, which will have to adjust its plans until the cooldowns expire.

Nevertheless, Ciuc Navi remains united. We stand behind our teammates and hope that this situation can be resolved fairly. Nobody expected the team's next roster adjustment to come from a Valve cooldown rather than an actual tactical decision.

For the time being, the affected players have been assigned an unexpected break from competitive Counter-Strike. Whether they'll use this time to touch grass, improve their aim in another game or simply stare at the VAC cooldown timer is yet to be confirmed.

A Message to Valve

We understand that maintaining fair play and protecting Counter-Strike from cheaters is important. However, situations like this are frustrating for legitimate players who find themselves caught up in the consequences of someone else's actions.

We hope Valve can take a closer look at situations of this nature and ensure that innocent players are not unfairly affected.

Until then, we will continue doing what we do best: playing together, supporting our teammates and patiently waiting for the server to welcome everyone back.

Seven days. Two players. One very unfortunate matchmaking experience.

Ciuc Navi will return to full strength soon. In the meantime, our unofficial training camp is temporarily sponsored by Valve.

#JusticeForCiucNavi #ValvePlsFix

Once NAVI, always NAVI.

news.text:
Ciuc Navi announces a change to its active Counter-Strike 2 roster.

After careful consideration and internal discussions, Ciuc Navi has decided to move stfandrei from the active roster to the bench.

Over the past month, stfandrei has been largely inactive, with limited involvement in the team's activities. As a team that wants to keep progressing, improving and competing together, consistency and commitment are important factors. With that in mind, we believe this change is the right step for the team's future and will allow us to move forward with a fresh start.

Of course, a roster change is never just about statistics, activity or performance. We also want to recognise the time, effort and contribution stfandrei has brought to Ciuc Navi. From the games we've played together to the unforgettable moments, questionable decisions and memories we've shared, he has been part of this team's journey, and that is something we genuinely appreciate.

We would like to thank him for everything he has contributed during his time with us and wish him nothing but the best in whatever comes next. This move does not erase his place in the Ciuc Navi story, and the door remains open for whatever the future may bring.

For now, the active roster moves forward with a new chapter ahead. As for stfandrei, he can finally enjoy some well-deserved time away from Premier. Perhaps his mouse can take a vacation too.

Thank you, stfandrei, and GLHF!

Once NAVI, always NAVI.
